meta.name: i-have-adhd
meta.description: Shape output for a reader with ADHD: lead with the next action, number multi-step work, restate state across turns, suppress tangents, give specific time estimates, make wins visible. Invoke with /i-have-adhd; stays on until "stop adhd mode".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让输出适配ADHD读者，突出行动项
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望AI回复更清晰易读，尤其是注意力不易集中时。
copy.tagline_en: Tailor output for ADHD readers: highlight next actions.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want AI responses that are easier to follow, especially when you have attention difficulties.

howto.what: Claude 的输出会以具体的下一步行动开头，将多步骤任务编号列出，每轮对话重述当前进度，避免题外话，给出具体时间估计，并明确展示已完成的成果。
howto.when: 当你说“/i-have-adhd”时触发，持续生效直到你说“stop adhd mode”。在编程、调试、解释等任意消息中也会自动应用。

say.text: 帮我调试这段代码，先做什么？
say.note: Claude 会以可立即执行的下一步行动开头。
Claude 会给出编号列表，每步一个操作。

howto.what_en: Claude's output will start with the concrete next action, number multi-step tasks, restate current state each turn, suppress tangents, give specific time estimates, and make completed work visible.
howto.when_en: Triggered by saying "/i-have-adhd" and stays on until "stop adhd mode". Also auto-applies to any message including coding, debugging, explanations, etc.

say_en.text: Help me debug this code, what should I do first?
say_en.note: Claude will lead with an immediately actionable step.

say_en.text: List the steps to fix this bug
say_en.note: Claude will provide a numbered list with one action per step.
